title: G6 transmitter battery drain
symptom: The user reports that two Dexcom G6 transmitters in a row ran low on battery much too early. The issue is not about scanning or connection, which work fine. The user asks if there are options to reduce battery drain.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive cause. The original poster later concluded it was an issue of the transmitters, not xDrip, but no root cause is identified.
fix: The thread does not state a fix. The original poster downgraded to an older version (1905161004) but later concluded the issue was with the transmitters, not xDrip. No resolution is provided.
evidence_quote: Finally it looks like it was an issue of the transmitters. The current transmitters looks good.
